Maria: heads-up: p99 for /v1/generate spiked to ~420ms at 10:11 UTC but route p99 shows ~180ms. p50/p95 stable.

Josh: was there a quota fallback around 10:11? can you drop the console query you used?

Maria: query I ran: SELECT percentile(response_ms, [50,95,99]) FROM latency WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND ts BETWEEN '2024-05-05T10:05Z' AND '2024-05-05T10:20Z' GROUP BY route, sample_source

Kevin: note: sample_source = gateway|cache_hit|backend. Route-level rollups historically drop sample_source so route p99 is dominated by gateway/cache t-digests while endpoint/backend p99 comes from backend-only histograms -> explains mismatch.

Maria: ok can we get counts by origin for that window?

Kevin: counts: gateway=1200, cache_hit=1020, backend=80

Liz: suggestion: show a small "origin" badge next to percentiles and surface effective-N per-percentile. show low-confidence indicator when effective-N < 100 so ops don't page on tiny-N tails.

Josh: I'll file a tracking ticket and add runbook note: "When route p99 != endpoint p99, check sample_origin counts and effective N before paging SRE." tagging eng-platform/oncall.

incident-bot: quota-fallback triggered client=acme-corp at 2024-05-05T10:11:07Z (routing -> fallback-model-v2).
